name: Four Seasons Resort the Nam Hai
insider_take: This beachfront sanctuary sits on pristine Ha My Beach, where ancient Vietnamese design meets Four Seasons luxury in perfect harmony.
whats_special: The resort's stunning architecture features traditional Vietnamese design with curved rooflines and natural materials. Each villa boasts private pools and direct beach access on one of Vietnam's most beautiful stretches of coastline. The property sits just 10 minutes from UNESCO World Heritage Site Hoi An Ancient Town, famous for its preserved 15th-century trading port and iconic Japanese Covered Bridge.
pro_tip: Book the sunrise yoga sessions on the beach - you'll have front-row seats to spectacular sunrises over the South China Sea while practicing on powder-soft sand.
dont_miss: The resort's cooking classes featuring Hoi An's famous cao lau noodles (made with water exclusively from local Ba Le wells), and evening visits to Hoi An's lantern-lit streets during the monthly Full Moon Festival when the town glows with thousands of colorful silk lanterns.
pros: Stunning beachfront location with pristine white sand beach and crystal-clear waters
Exceptional spa and wellness facilities with traditional Vietnamese treatments
Luxurious villas with private pools and authentic Vietnamese architectural design
World-class dining experiences featuring fresh local ingredients and international cuisine
cons: Secluded location requires transportation to reach Hoi An Ancient Town
